app.disclaimer: SAS Connect is a demonstration prototype. Images and resident information are for demonstration purposes only.

empty.text: Items will appear here once there is something to show.

placeholder.description: This page is a placeholder in the new design system. Its real content arrives in a later phase.
placeholder.quickText: Share something nice that happened today with residents' families.
placeholder.cardText: Buttons, status badges and dialogs shown here are the building blocks for every screen.
placeholder.dialogText: Press Escape, the Close button or the dark area to close. Focus returns to the button that opened it.

replyTemplate.t1: Thank you for checking in. Your loved one is doing well today.
replyTemplate.t2: We have received your question and will provide an update when available.
replyTemplate.t3: Please contact the nursing home directly if you would like to discuss this further.

residentNotes.wong: Had a restless night. Please call the ward when convenient.

m1.title: Morning Garden Walk
m1.caption: Madam Tan and Mr Lim enjoyed fresh air and sunshine during this morning's garden walk.

m2.title: Music Therapy Session
m2.caption: Residents sang along to old favourites and kept the beat with tambourines.

m3.title: Paper Lantern Craft
m3.caption: A relaxed morning of folding and colouring paper lanterns together.

m4.title: Seated Group Exercise
m4.caption: Gentle stretching and ball games led by our physiotherapy team.

m5.title: Birthday Celebration
m5.caption: We celebrated Mr Lim's birthday with cake, songs and a card signed by everyone.

m6.title: Evening Singalong
m6.caption: Residents are invited to join tonight's singalong in the day room.

q1.question: How has my mother's cough been today?

q2.question: Can my father have less salt in his meals?

q3.question: May I drop off a new cardigan this weekend?

q4.question: Can I bring home-cooked porridge when I visit?
q4.reply: Yes, you are welcome to. Please let the nurse on duty know when you arrive so we can check her diet plan.

q5.question: Is my father still doing his physiotherapy exercises?
q5.reply: Yes, he attends physiotherapy three times a week and is making good progress.

e1.title: Community Gathering
e1.description: Join residents, families and volunteers for songs, tea and festive snacks. Wheelchair access and seating are provided throughout.

e2.title: Music Therapy Open Afternoon
e2.description: Families are invited to watch and join a live music therapy session and see how sponsored activities support residents.

e3.title: Family Appreciation Day
e3.description: A thank-you afternoon for the families who support our residents.

e4.title: Festive Tea Gathering
e4.description: A festive tea with traditional snacks and a short cultural performance by volunteers.

e5.title: Volunteer Appreciation Tea
e5.description: A thank-you afternoon for the volunteers who spend time with our residents every week.

n1.title: Visiting hours stay the same this festive season
n1.summary: Visits remain available daily. Please book a slot in advance so we can welcome everyone comfortably.

n2.title: Volunteers needed for the Community Gathering
n2.summary: We are looking for friendly helpers to assist residents on the day. Speak to the care team if you would like to help.

n3.title: New seated exercise programme
n3.summary: Residents now enjoy a gentle seated exercise class three mornings a week.

v1.title: Resident Befriending
v1.description: Spend time chatting, reading or playing simple games with residents who would enjoy company.

v2.title: Activity Assistance
v2.description: Help our activities team set up and support residents during arts, music and exercise sessions.

v3.title: Festive Celebration Support
v3.description: Lend a hand with decorations, refreshments and guiding residents during festive celebrations.

home.intro: Here is how your loved ones are doing, and what is coming up.

moments.intro: Activities and well-being updates from the care team, shared only with the families involved.
moments.disclaimer: These are general updates from the care team, not medical assessments. For health concerns, please speak to the nursing home.
moments.emptyText: Check back soon, or try a different filter.

ask.title: Ask the care team
ask.cta: Have a question about care, meals or visits? Send it here and the team will reply.
ask.question: Your question
ask.urgent: For urgent matters, please call the nursing home directly. Messages here are not answered in real time.
ask.sent: Your question has been sent. The care team will reply here.
ask.noHistory: You have not asked anything about this resident yet.

visits.intro: Book, change or review your visits. Please book a slot so we can welcome everyone comfortably.
visits.cancelText: {date}, {time}. The time slot will be released for other families.

community.intro: Events, news and ways to help at the nursing home.

share.title: Share this event
share.note: Only public event details are shared. Resident updates are never shared.
share.private: This event is for residents and families only, so it cannot be shared publicly.

volunteer.title: Volunteer with us
volunteer.intro: A few hours can make a real difference to a resident's week.
volunteer.demo: Demo only: nothing was sent and no personal details were collected.

support.title: Support SAS
support.text: Your gift helps fund activities like music therapy, which bring comfort and joy to residents.
support.note: Opens the official SAS website in a new tab. Donations are not processed in this prototype.
